design_philosophy: Warm, uplifting, and human-centered. We aim to evoke energy and inclusion through bold hopeful colors (deep green and warm orange) paired with generous breathing room (clean whites) and impactful, accessible typography.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary-900

guidelines: Avoid Inter/Roboto completely. Use Outfit for a distinct, energetic punch on headings, and DM Sans for highly accessible body text.
Ensure heading line-heights are tight (leading-tight) and body line-heights are relaxed (leading-relaxed) for maximum legibility.
Never center-align long blocks of text; keep paragraphs left-aligned.

marketing.hero: Full-bleed or split-screen structure. If using full-bleed background image, apply bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA. Left-aligned massive typography with two distinct CTAs (Primary Accent for 'Donate', Outline/White for 'Volunteer').
marketing.bento_programs: Tetris Grid (Mode A). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Span logic: Hero component col-span-12 lg:col-span-8, supporting components col-span-12 lg:col-span-4.
marketing.spacing: Generous. Use py-20, py-24, or py-32 for section padding. Containers must breathe.
marketing.navigation: Sticky crystal glass header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/20. No completely transparent headers over content.

admin.structure: Sidebar navigation (w-64) + Main content area. High Density Grid (Mode B) for dashboard widgets.
admin.widgets: Flat white surfaces (bg-white), subtle border-border/60, rounded-xl, no heavy shadows. Strict data hierarchy.
admin.spacing: Tight and functional. p-6 for cards, gap-4 for grids.

buttons.marketing: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bold px-8 py-4. Accent color for primary CTAs to drive action (Donate, Register). Add subtle hover transforms (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow.
buttons.admin: Standard rounding (rounded-md), px-4 py-2. Function-first, solid primary or muted secondary.

cards.marketing: Soft corners (rounded-3xl), bg-white, subtle ambient shadow (shadow-sm). Use generous internal padding (p-8 to p-12).

components.forms: Use Shadcn UI customized to match the brand. Input fields should have rounded-lg borders, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent.
components.sponsors: Instead of placeholder images, use stylized typography (e.g., 'font-serif text-2xl font-bold tracking-widest text-muted-foreground') paired with Lucide icons (Hexagon, Circle) to represent sponsor logos gracefully.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA minimum. Use APCA contrast tools to ensure dark text on warm orange or deep green backgrounds remains legible. If using text over images, mandate text-shadow and a dark/light semi-transparent underlay.
accessibility.keyboard: Ensure clear focus states (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-accent) for all interactive elements.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Animations should be subtle (opacity fades, slight Y-axis shifts).
accessibility.structure: Maintain a strictly semantic HTML hierarchy (H1 -> H2 -> H3). Use proper aria-labels on icon-only buttons.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., data-testid='donate-submit-button').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create depth via layered elements and z-index hierarchy.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠) for icons. Use lucide-react.
All interactions need micro-animations (hover states, subtle scale, color transition).
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder text or placeholder image URLs for missing content. Use stylized text or lucide icons if no image is available.
